content:
oncall-rio: alerting — embedder eu-west1 5xx spike ~4.8%. Quick patch ready in v2.1.4-hotfix (kv-cache off-by-one). Requesting expedited deploy and skip-canary for region-only.

deploy-bot: HOTFIX_REQUEST service=embedder region=eu-west1 image=embedder:v2.1.4-hotfix-kv trigger=alert-embed-5xx

tess: How localized? Any downstream dependencies?

oncall-rio: Localized to eu-west1 nodes. No schema change. Repro on 2/4 synthetic runs. Image built and scanned.

maya: Security scan green. No perms change. +1.

loren: SRE ok if rollback triggers in place and smoke tests mandatory. Add auto-cutback rule.

prod-pm-ana: Product ok. Please include short release note for status page.

eng-lead-janet: I approve expedited flow for eu-west1 only. Conditions: rollback criteria, smoke, and support notified.

oncall-rio: Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >1% for 3m OR p95 +300ms for 5m OR logs show "kv-index-fail" after deploy.

loren: Also: node-failure >2 in 2m triggers 50% traffic cutback. Ensure KV prefix invalidation post-deploy.

eng-lead-janet: Good. Proceed when support is pinged.

deploy-bot: APPROVALS 4/4. Executing deploy skip_canary=true rollout=immediate

deploy-bot: step 1 drain -> OK
deploy-bot: step 2 apply image -> OK
deploy-bot: smoke: `./tools/embedder-quick-check --region eu-west1`

oncall-rio: smoke x8 queries PASS, no 5xx. Logs indicate kv index fix.

deploy-bot: finalize -> 100% traffic. Telemetry: 5xx returned to baseline, p95 stable.

oncall-rio: Support notified, status page updated (INC-5489). Scheduling +15m post-verification.

eng-lead-janet: Incident mitigated. Follow-up RCA to be filed.

tess: Thanks team. :tada:
